title: LaRe: Latent Refocusing for Multimodal Reasoning

access.version_basis: Visible arXiv stamp on PDF p.1; latest remote version not checked because local full text was available.
sections_read: Appendix A Implementation Details; Algorithm 1; Table 6; Figure 6
Appendix B.2 More Analysis; Tables 12–18; Eq.9; Figure 7
Appendix C Case Study; Figure 8; D Discussion; E Usage of LLMs

rs.innovation_approach: 用动态隐状态查询原图视觉 token，在连续 latent 中反复聚焦；以去噪视觉重建辅助监督压缩后的视觉证据。
rs.key_step: 每步从 LLM 各层抽取隐藏表示，经两层 self-attention/cross-attention Extractor 查询固定原图 VT，追加 Z(k)；K=4 后再解码回答。训练时用全部 Z 条件化 U-Net 预测噪声。
rs.why_non_obvious: 显式重看通常增加图像 token；已有 latent 推理则可能仅传播静态视觉初始化。本方法将重查询原视觉特征与 latent 更新绑定，同时用重建约束信息保留。
rs.trigger_condition: When iterative evidence access is useful but explicit observation tokens dominate decoding cost, apply state-conditioned latent refocusing with reconstruction supervision to retain evidence while shortening generated text.
rs.acceptance_signal: low_evidence: manifest has no review source or decision; local arXiv v4 is not acceptance evidence.
rs.abstract_strategy: Replace repeated explicit intermediate observations with a compact state that repeatedly queries the original evidence.
rs.abstract_key_step: Use the evolving internal state to query fixed evidence, append the fused state, and train the accumulated states to reconstruct corrupted source features.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: Preserve dynamic evidence access while compressing its representation; avoid treating compression as a one-time loss of access.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When repeated explicit intermediates are costly but static compression loses relevant detail, repeatedly condition a compact update on source evidence and supervise its reconstructability.

signatures.object: LLM reasoning-time intermediate representation and visual reread operator
signatures.information: Current question, original encoded visual tokens VT, historical latent blocks, hidden state from each LLM layer. No new high-resolution crop pixels, external tool result, gold region or ground-truth answer at inference.
signatures.operation: Repeat K times: extract layer-aligned hidden states, run self-attention then cross-attention to VT, pass through GLU/FFN, append new latent tokens; bracket accumulated latents with bot/eot and decode answer.
signatures.output: K latent blocks of l tokens followed by autoregressive final text; K=4 and l=number of LLM layers.
signatures.claimed_effect: Author-reported Table 3 (4B): full 74.7% / 65.0 output tokens versus without Extractor 69.3% / 89.1. Table 7 fixed-query variant 72.9% / 67.5; this isolates dynamic query relative to learned fixed queries, but does not by itself prove attention is causal.
conditions: Original encoder must retain necessary visual information; refocusing cannot create absent pixels.
Architecture must expose per-layer hidden states and support recurrent latent-input blocks.
K fixed and all steps executed; visual encoder/projector described as frozen.

evidence.quote:
Meanwhile, discarding the Extractor leads to a 5.4% drop in accuracy and a massive
surge in token consumption (+24.1), demonstrating that the iterative refocusing mechanism is vital
for pinpointing reasoning-relevant visual cues and
preventing the model from generating verbose, redundant outputs.

signatures.failure_boundary: Fixed K may waste compute or underthink (p.9); Table 8 heuristic halting underperforms. No crop-selection or recover policy is learned. Architectural/configuration inconsistencies noted below.

signatures.object: Supervision on the full accumulated latent reasoning sequence
signatures.information: Training image represented by KL-16 image tokenizer; sampled Gaussian noise and timestep; all latent Z; final target text for separate NTP loss. No labeled necessity/causal region or per-step crop value.
signatures.operation: Corrupt image features with a diffusion noise schedule, predict injected noise with a latent-conditioned U-Net, and add its squared-error loss to final-text cross entropy with lambda_rec=1.
signatures.output: Latent states encouraged to preserve reconstructable visual information; denoiser omitted at inference.
signatures.claimed_effect: Author-reported Table 4 on MMStar/MMMU-Pro/MMVP: feature-denoising 62.9% average; no reconstruction 56.6%; feature regression 60.4%; pixel denoising 61.5%; pixel regression 58.9%. Table 3 across seven benchmarks removing semantic augmentation gives 67.2% versus 74.7%. Source inconsistency (visually checked p.7 Table4): no-reconstruction cells 68.5,54.6,51.8 average to58.3, not the printed/prose56.6. Preserve56.6 as author-reported only; it cannot support a reconstructed6.3pp ablation effect. Row-derived full mean62.933 minus58.3 is about4.63pp, pending clarification of aggregation/erratum.
conditions: Need image-feature reconstruction targets and additional trainable denoiser during training.
Reconstruction target tokenizer and loss weight matter; KL-16 beats four alternatives in Table 9.
Gradient-path implementation not released in the supplied artifact; module updates not fully consistent across prose and Table 13.

evidence.quote:
Experimental results indicate that the removal of
the reconstruction loss Lrec leads to a significant
performance decline across all benchmarks, where
the average accuracy drops from 62.9% to 56.6%.

signatures.failure_boundary: Reconstructability is not a per-action necessity label or proof of correct evidence use; no reward hacking or multi-round credit experiment.

limitations.text: Fixed iteration count cannot allocate computation by instance need; both redundant and insufficient computation are possible.
limitations.quote:
A primary limitation of the current LaRe framework is its reliance on a predefined, static number
of reasoning iterations K. While our empirical
analysis identifies an optimal saturation threshold
for performance, this "one-size-fits-all" approach
does not account for the varying complexity across
different multimodal tasks. For relatively straightforward visual queries, a fixed number of latent
iterations may introduce redundant computational
overhead and unnecessary latency. Conversely, for
exceptionally intricate logical reasoning tasks, the
model’s performance may still be constrained by
the preset iteration limit.

question.observed_failure: Authors identify expensive explicit visual refocusing versus static latent context. Table 1 4B CoF uses 271.1 tokens on V* at 83.7%; LaRe reports 93.5 at 87.0%. This is a reported baseline gap, not an independent diagnosis or controlled causal comparison (CoF uses original post-training).
question.load_bearing_assumption: Effective visual refocusing must appear as explicit tokens; a continuous latent loop can instead retain access to the original image features.
question.scope: Visual-CoT-supervised latent reasoning on seven image QA/perception benchmarks, mainly Qwen3-VL-2B/4B and 8B comparison; no multi-turn crop RL.
question.success_criterion: Improve answer accuracy with fewer generated output tokens and lower complete inference latency; authors do not predefine statistical noninferiority bounds.
question.why_open: Prior latent approaches compress or initialize visual information without equivalent dynamic evidence access and reconstruction supervision; explicit tool/image reasoning incurs token overhead.

moves.quote:
full LaRe configuration achieves the most competitive performance, striking a superior balance
between reasoning accuracy (74.7%) and inference
efficiency (65.0 tokens).
moves.note: Performance/efficiency jointly measured, but no formal noninferiority test.

moves.quote:
investigate the architectural design of the Extractor through a series of ablation experiments on a
4B parameter backbone, as summarized in Table
7.
moves.note: Component ablations isolate self-attention, dynamic versus fixed query, and simpler projection/pooling alternatives.

moves.quote:
Specifically, latent refocusing does not rely on
explicit image tokens for refocusing. Instead it
introduces a set of iteratively evolving latent representations.
moves.note: Replaces explicit refocusing representation with compact dynamic latents; performance preservation is empirical, not a proved equivalence. Other taxonomy labels omitted: no assumption theorem, no property-exclusive pretext guarantee.

equations.locator: Eq.9, p.16; diagnostic only, not training loss

objective.signal_routing: NTP supervises target response tokens after the full latent chain. Reconstruction uses all Z as U-Net conditioning; gradients are intended to shape the shared latent representation, not assign distinct signed credit to a crop/stop action. Encoder/projector described frozen. No RL advantage, per-turn reward or caption/action token mask. Exact detach/update paths are not specified and Sec.4.2 only-LLM wording conflicts with trainable module counts in Table 13.
objective.normalization: other: Eq.7 sums over response positions; Eq.6 expects squared L2 noise error. No GRPO std, group centering or leave-one-out. Loss-reduction conventions across feature dimensions/batch are unspecified. Extractor has Norm; diagnostic attention is normalized; probe representations are L2 normalized, none is reward normalization.
objective.invariance: No policy-optimality invariance theorem or potential-based shaping. Architecture and SFT objective change; original image VT reused across steps and denoiser removed at inference. Lower output tokens is not invariant total compute.
objective.baseline_or_potential: No critic/value/potential baseline. Reconstruction target is encoded image plus known injected Gaussian noise; NTP target is supervised text. Appendix D RL reward/halting is future work.
objective.degenerate_cases: p≈0/1, all-correct/all-wrong groups: n/a to this SFT method. lambda_rec=0 is ablated (Table4 prints56.6%, while its three cells average58.3%; unresolved source arithmetic, not a verified6.3pp effect). K=1 retains one latent refocus but no interstep diagnostic; Eq.9 undefined at K=1. K=0 not tested. If image encoder loses small details, re-querying VT cannot recover new high-resolution pixels (reader inference). Identical entropy across spatially permuted attention maps yields VAED=0 although attention can move; Top-5 Jaccard helps but is not a semantic correctness label.

evidence_design.discriminating_experiment: Table 7 dynamic versus fixed query, self-attention removal, linear/pooling substitutions; Table 4 denoising versus regression and feature versus pixel targets; Table 12 MCOUT+Cross-Attn without reconstruction. Table 15 masks top-20%, bottom-20%, random-20% patches, plus all-steps condition; on MMStar drops 11.4/1.1/5.3/13.9 points. Table 17 step-1 deletion costs 6.3 points versus step-4 1.1. These support intervention sensitivity; attention selectivity alone cannot prove purposefulness or rule out parameter/training confounds.
controls: Same Qwen3-VL backbones and Visual-CoT SFT for most Table 1 arms; CoF and LVR retain original post-training so not completely matched.
Fixed learned query vs evolving hidden-state query; no-Extractor/no-semantic-loss/both; feature/pixel regression/denoising; multiple tokenizers.
Low-attention and random same-fraction mask controls; all-step mask and latent-step ablations. No reported shuffled-semantic/parameter-and-compute-matched refocus control.

Probe: 1000 balanced pairs, negatives from different-question/same-image, different-image/same-question, random batch; stratified 70/30 split; five-fold training CV. Not seed replication of model training.
K=1..6 per benchmark, N=1,2,4,8,10,12; Table 14 total latent-plus-decoding latency.

negative_results.text: Heuristic adaptive halting is worse than fixed K=4: cosine averages 5.9 steps / 74.5%; L1 2.8 / 73.1%; L2 2.9 / 74.2%, versus 4 / 74.7% (Table 8); generated tokens also rise to 67.8/71.3/70.5 from 65.0.
negative_results.quote:
While adaptive stopping potentially mitigates redundancy and excessive computation, it results in a slight decline in
overall performance metrics.

negative_results.text: Extractor depth beyond 4 has marginal gains under 0.5 point while latency grows; default N=2.
negative_results.quote:
Specifically, increasing N beyond 4 yields
marginal improvements of less than 0.5%, whereas
inference latency continues to grow.

evidence_design.uncertainty: Number of training/evaluation seeds and accuracy confidence intervals not reported. Table 5 attention-distribution tests report p-values, not training-seed uncertainty; no basis to assert single seed as fact.
evidence_design.falsifier: Reader-proposed: under matched backbonecompute budgets, state-conditioned attention must outperform fixed or shuffled queries; masking its high-attention regions must hurt more than matched random/saliency regions. Failure would weaken dynamic evidence-selection claim. Recompute latency including all K*l latent tokens/forward passes; if savings vanish, token count alone fails efficiency claim.

engineering.cost: Table 13: 2B full 1.77B trainable params, 2.88 s/iter, 13h30m, 26.08GB versus CoT 1.72B, 2.62s, 12h17m, 24.25GB. 4B full 4.08B, 4.96s/iter, 23h29m, 41.20GB versus CoT 4.02B, 4.59s, 21h44m, 38.15GB. GPU-memory aggregation scope not explicit. Table 14 average total inference 0.54s (2B) and 0.82s (4B), versus LVR .60/.90 and CoT 1.15/2.09. Training token/update counts absent. Reconstruction visualization U-Net separately fine-tuned 5 epochs on ImageNet-1K; do not confuse with main SFT epochs.

pitfalls.text: Fixed latent iterations create latency even on easy tasks; adaptive convergence thresholds were not a successful fix.
pitfalls.quote:
For relatively straightforward visual queries, a fixed number of latent
iterations may introduce redundant computational
overhead and unnecessary latency.

engineering.lesson: 当把显式视觉重看压到连续状态时，应同时验证表示是否保留证据、遮蔽干预是否依赖这些证据，并计入所有 latent 前向与解码耗时；固定迭代减少文本不等于学会按需停止。

relevance.how: Fixed-K latent iteration and failed cosine/L1/L2 adaptive stopping give a boundary case; no trained remaining-budget crop stopper.

Image reconstruction auxiliary supervision suggests preserving evidence in intermediate representations; caption faithfulness and RL drift are not tested and require different targets/gradient routing.
Table 15 high/low/random visual masking can inform evidence-use diagnostics; reconstruction/attention is not a per-crop reward or necessity truth.
2B/4B/8B and supplementary two model families offer architecture-transfer evidence within authors setup; no verification of 8K input or our crop protocol.
Reported training overhead and total latency distinguish latent compute from generated token savings; method requires architecture change rather than cheaper fork estimation.
